## Gaps to fix

1. **[high] shadcn-usage** — ConnectionCard.tsx uses a raw clickable div for the menu trigger (MoreHorizontal icon) instead of a shadcn Button or DropdownMenu component. Line contains onClick handler on a div without proper button semantics.
   Fix: Replace the clickable div with either a Button component or implement a proper DropdownMenu from shadcn/ui with DropdownMenuTrigger, DropdownMenuContent, and DropdownMenuItem components

2. **[high] accessibility** — The menu implementation in ConnectionCard.tsx lacks proper ARIA attributes. The clickable menu trigger div needs role='button', aria-expanded, and aria-haspopup. The menu container needs role='menu' and proper focus management.
   Fix: Add role='button', aria-expanded={menuOpen}, aria-haspopup='true', and aria-label='Connection options' to the trigger. Implement proper focus trap and keyboard navigation (Escape to close, Arrow keys for navigation) or use shadcn DropdownMenu which provides this automatically
   Where: src/components/atlas/ConnectionCard.tsx

   Fix: Replace raw <select> with shadcn Select component: <Select value={action} onValueChange={setAction}><SelectTrigger>...</SelectTrigger><SelectContent><SelectItem>...</SelectItem></SelectContent></Select>
   Where: src/pages/atlas/settings/AuditPage.tsx:52

   Where: src/pages/atlas/settings/SettingsLayout.tsx:60

5. **[medium] accessibility** — ConnectionCard.tsx menu items (Test, Reveal, Delete actions) appear to be rendered as divs or spans with onClick handlers rather than proper button elements with keyboard support. The truncated code suggests a custom menu implementation without Enter/Space key handlers.

   Where: src/components/atlas/ConnectionCard.tsx

6. **[low] mobile-responsive** — ConnectionCard component is described as '240×140 card' with fixed dimensions, but the implementation is truncated. Need to verify this uses responsive units (w-60 h-35 or similar) rather than fixed pixels that would violate the 'no fixed pixel widths' anti-pattern.
